name: Landhaus Stigger
beschreibung: Landhaus Stigger welcomes vacationers to a sunny and accessible setting in Ötztal-Bahnhof at the entrance to the world-famous Ötztal Valley. This family-run residence provides cozy alpine-style rooms and holiday apartments equipped with modern amenities and private balconies overlooking the mountains. Its strategic position allows guests to reach the renowned AREA 47 adventure park, scenic riverside cycling trails, and Inn Valley sights in just minutes. In winter, top-tier ski resorts including Hochoetz, Kühtai, Sölden, and Gurgl provide endless snow-sure skiing.
kurzbeschreibung: Comfortable holiday retreat in Ötztal-Bahnhof at the entrance to the Ötztal Valley near Area 47.
